integrity: An analytic proof and reproducible numerical and symbolic tests are provided; these tests supplement rather than replace proof. Novelty is qualified by close prior general information-analysis methods and incomplete universal priority knowledge.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for an isolated rectangular transit with known ephemeris and baseline, phase-averaged depth-only Fisher information, deterministic exposure dead time, independent zero-mean Gaussian errors with variance v/E+w, and unbounded observing support. Not an empirical survey-optimization prescription; independent validation is absent.
title: A sharp longer-than-transit exposure threshold under dead time and independent noise floors
